title: Hengqin-RA-v1: Advanced Large Language Model for Diagnosis and Treatment of Rheumatoid Arthritis with Dataset based Traditional Chinese Medicine

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy and passing rates of various Chinese and non-Chinese Large Language Models (LLMs) on the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Examination benchmark to demonstrate performance disparities caused by the underrepresentation of Chinese corpora in training data.

Conducting expert qualitative evaluations on generated medical diagnostic and treatment recommendations to assess the model's ability to capture the specific cultural and clinical subtleties of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) compared to general or Western-centric medical models.
